records.value: Applicants for a Finnish residence permit for studies must have been accepted by a Finnish educational institution; eligible studies generally lead to a degree or vocational qualification, with exchange study also covered. The studies must require residence in Finland rather than mainly being online distance learning.

Applicants must have at least EUR 800 available per month for living costs; for a one-year permit this means EUR 9,600 in the applicant's bank account when applying, in addition to funds needed for unpaid tuition fees where applicable.
